description: This file defines the PdfObjectReference class, which represents a marked-content reference in a PDF document within the PdfSharp library. It includes constructors and a nested class for dictionary keys related to the object reference.

classes.name: PdfObjectReference
classes.description: Represents a marked-content reference in a PDF structure, inheriting from PdfDictionary, with constructors setting the object type and a nested class defining dictionary keys.

classes.name: Keys
classes.description: Defines the keys used in the PdfObjectReference dictionary, including type, page, and object references.

methods.name: PdfObjectReference()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the dictionary type to '/OBJR'.

methods.name: PdfObjectReference(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor that sets the document owner and initializes the type.
